IP Translation and Filing Client Care Specialist  Sun IP is a global leader in patent translation, foreign filing, and annuity solutions, helping intellectual property professionals protect innovation worldwide. We are looking for a motivated, process-focused, IP-knowledgeable Client Care Specialist to join our Filings and Translations department — a collaborative team dedicated to delivering exceptional service to a sophisticated global clientele. Success in this role demands genuine IP knowledge and a meticulous eye for detail. You will be working across a high volume of concurrent matters, each with its own instructions, deadlines, and data requirements — so the ability to prioritize accurately and act before things escalate is essential. You will take a proactive approach to every interaction: anticipating what a client needs, ensuring records are complete and correct, and entering data with the precision that IP demands. This is not a reactive role. It is one where staying ahead of the work, asking the right questions early, and keeping every case moving is what defines a great day. This is a role for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment and takes genuine satisfaction in getting the details right. You will manage multiple matters simultaneously across a diverse client base, bringing IP expertise, sharp judgment, and a client-first mindset to everything you do. Main Responsibilities  Serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of global IP clients, handling enquiries with professionalism, accuracy, and a proactive approach to resolution. Process patent translation requests in connection with international filings, ensuring all instructions are interpreted correctly and actioned without delay. Manage client correspondence across high-volume shared inboxes, triaging and prioritizing matters according to urgency and deadline sensitivity. Enter and maintain accurate data within our workflow management platform, upholding data integrity at every stage. Follow up with clients on outstanding filing requirements, documentation, and approaching deadlines — anticipating gaps before they become issues. Analyze complex filing instructions and translate them into clear, actionable tasks for internal teams, removing ambiguity and keeping matters on track. Collaborate cross-functionally with Project Management, Accounting, Sales, and other departments to coordinate client deliverables and resolve escalations. Identify and resolve inconsistencies or errors in client instructions, escalating where necessary and always keeping the client informed. Produce and manipulate reports in Microsoft Excel to support internal tracking, client updates, and workflow oversight. Contribute to a culture of continuous improvement by sharing process insights and supporting broader team and company objectives. Manage proactive client contact, ensuring clients are kept informed at every stage of their matters and no update is left outstanding. Act as primary contact for client profile management, maintaining accurate account records, preferences, and filing instructions across all platforms. Lead client onboarding, guiding new clients through Sun IP’s processes, systems, and service offering to ensure a confident and informed start. Deliver virtual training sessions for clients, equipping them with the knowledge to work effectively with our team and tools.  Required Experience  Prior experience in the patent filing industry; experience as a patent filing paralegal is strongly preferred. Demonstrable experience processing patent translation requests in connection with international patent filings. Hands-on experience with docketing systems or similar workflow management platforms. Experience managing client-facing communication around filing requirements, deadlines, and documentation. Strong verbal and written communication skills - you can explain things clearly and confidently, whether in email, one-to-one call, or group meeting. description:

About Turing  Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems. Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM, and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies. Role Overview  In this role, you will be working on projects to help fine-tune large language models (like ChatGPT) using your strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, review and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles! The projects will also help you learn how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world! Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world! What does day-to-day look like:   You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Estabelecer boas práticas de engenharia (Versionamento; CI/CD; Testes; Observabilidade e infraestrutura como código - IaC). Garantir confiabilidade, escalabilidade e custo-eficiência (FinOps) da plataforma de dados. Atuar como referência técnica do time de dados (Revisões de arquitetura; Code review; Mentoria e definição de padrões) Traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções técnicas. Orientar decisões de arquitetura em AWS. Apoiar planejamento técnico, estimativas e evolução do roadmap da plataforma.

title: Remote Business Analyst (German)
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Remote Business Analyst (German) em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

About Turing:  Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems. Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies. Role Overview:  We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles! Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world! What does day-to-day look like:  You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn: Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?) In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.  Requirements:  Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)  Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations. Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities. Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting. Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours. Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.  Preferred Qualifications:  Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area. Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.) Understanding of Excel and Google Suite. Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.  Perks of Freelancing With Turing:  Work in a fully remote environment. Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies. Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.  Offer Details:  Engagement type :  Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave) Commitments Required :  Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles  Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Head of Compliance, Brazil
description:
Empresa está contratando Head of Compliance, Brazil em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Overview  We are seeking an experienced Head of Compliance & MLRO to oversee the company's compliance and regulatory responsibilities in Brazil. This role will support the business in maintaining a strong compliance culture, managing regulatory relationships, and ensuring alignment with applicable legal and regulatory requirements. Working closely with local and regional stakeholders, the successful candidate will provide practical compliance guidance while supporting the company's growth and licensing initiatives in Brazil. Key Responsibilities  Serve as the designated MLRO and lead compliance representative for the Brazil business. Oversee the company's compliance, AML/CFT, sanctions, and financial crime programs. Monitor regulatory developments and provide guidance on relevant regulatory requirements. Maintain relationships with regulators and support regulatory enquiries, reviews, and examinations. Support licensing, registration, and other regulatory initiatives as required. Provide compliance advice to business and operational teams on new products, services, and business activities. Help ensure policies, procedures, and controls remain effective and aligned with regulatory expectations. Oversee key compliance processes, including customer due diligence, transaction monitoring, and suspicious activity reporting. Identify compliance risks and work with stakeholders to implement appropriate controls and solutions. Prepare compliance updates and reporting for management. Deliver compliance training and promote a strong culture of compliance across the organization. Collaborate with regional and global teams on compliance-related matters.  Requirements  Bachelor's degree in Law, Finance, Business, Accounting, or a related field. Experience in Compliance, AML/Financial Crime, Regulatory Affairs, or a related function within financial services, fintech, payments, banking, or digital assets. Prior experience as an MLRO, Compliance Officer, or similar compliance role is preferred. Good understanding of Brazilian regulatory requirements and AML/CFT obligations. Experience interacting with regulators, auditors, or other external stakeholders is advantageous. Exposure to licensing, regulatory approvals, or compliance projects is beneficial. Experience within digital assets, fintech, payments, or financial institutions is preferred. Strong communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills. Ability to work independently in a dynamic and evolving environment. Professional certifications such as CAMS, ICA, CFE, or equivalent are a plus. Fluency in English and Portuguese.  Vision & Mission  OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

For our international customer in Valencia, we are looking for a ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer. The role focuses on ongoing APM data maintenance in ServiceNow (APM/CMDB-related records as applicable), identifying data gaps and inconsistencies, coordinating updates with application/service owners, and tracking technical debt indicators and remediation progress.  EU candidates are welcome to apply. Candidates need to be based in Valencia or willing to relocate to Valencia. Candidates need to be flexible to work across time zones, including alignment with US Eastern Time where required. Work permit is not provided. Candidates need to be fluent in English. Tasks and responsibilities:  Perform ongoing maintenance of Application Portfolio Management (APM) data within ServiceNow, including application inventory, ownership, lifecycle status, technology attributes, and documented integrations/dependencies, ensuring data accuracy, completeness, and currency; Identify and remediate data quality issues such as missing or invalid values, duplicate records, and inconsistent classifications through coordination with application owners, service owners, and relevant stakeholders; Maintain and enhance portfolio data governance standards and controlled vocabularies, including lifecycle states, business and technical fit assessments, and application criticality classifications; Monitor and track technical debt indicators leveraging ServiceNow portfolio data, including lifecycle and obsolescence risks, unsupported technologies, architectural non-conformities, and resilience or operability gaps; Maintain a centralized log or aligned ServiceNow records documenting technical debt items, including impacted applications/services, severity and priority ratings, and recommended remediation actions such as retirement, replacement, or modernization; Develop and deliver recurring dashboards, reports, and portfolio insights for the onsite Enterprise Architect, including technical debt trends, aging remediation items, progress tracking, and portfolio risk hotspots; Translate stakeholder inputs, priorities, and publishing schedules into updates for the APM website and related communication materials; Maintain and support the APM website as a central platform for publishing portfolio data, standards, insights, lifecycle guidance, and reference information related to Application Portfolio Management practices;  Profile:  Master’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline; +8 years of overall experience in Information Technology; +3 years of experience supporting Enterprise Architects or working within Enterprise Architecture teams; Hands-on experience with ServiceNow, specifically supporting Application Portfolio Management (APM) data, including application and CMDB records, data validation, monitoring, maintenance, and reporting; Strong understanding of Application Portfolio Management (APM) principles, including application inventory management, lifecycle governance, business and technical fit assessments, risk and obsolescence analysis, and application rationalization strategies (retire, replace, modernize); Proven experience identifying, documenting, and tracking technical debt, including the definition of debt indicators, maintenance of remediation records, and generation of actionable reporting and insights; Solid understanding of Enterprise Architecture concepts and practices, including architecture principles, standards, governance, target-state architecture, roadmaps, and architecture deliverables, as well as the role of portfolio data in strategic decision-making; Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with distributed stakeholders to resolve data quality issues and drive timely completion of application and portfolio record updates; Previous experience delivering similar ServiceNow APM and technical debt management activities within large or complex enterprise environments is highly preferred; Strong analytical, reporting, and problem-solving capabilities, including experience producing dashboards, scorecards, KPI reporting, and trend analysis with a strong focus on data integrity and attention to detail; AI literacy, including practical experience using AI and Generative AI tools to enhance productivity in areas such as data analysis, reporting, documentation, and knowledge management, within approved enterprise governance frameworks; Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document processes, prepare executive-ready materials, and communicate findings effectively to Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders; Working knowledge of Enterprise Architecture frameworks and methodologies such as TOGAF and their practical application in enterprise architecture deliverables and governance processes; Working knowledge of ServiceNow data model fundamentals relevant to Application Portfolio Management, including CMDB structures, application records, CSDM concepts, and portfolio data governance practices; Relevant certifications are considered an advantage, including:  TOGAF or equivalent Enterprise Architecture certification; ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA); ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) and/or relevant ServiceNow implementation certifications related to APM or CMDB; Experience with enterprise architecture and portfolio management tooling, including ServiceNow EA Workspace and APM reporting capabilities, is considered a plus; Familiarity with responsible AI principles and the secure use of enterprise AI assistants, including prompt hygiene and protection of sensitive information, is considered an advantage; Fluent in English;

evolução do ecossistema de segurança da Google.  O foco da posição está na construção de arquiteturas seguras, operação de plataformas de detecção e resposta a ameaças, proteção de dados, gestão de postura de segurança e fortalecimento dos controles de identidade e produtividade corporativa.  Buscamos um profissional que combine forte conhecimento técnico com capacidade consultiva para liderar discussões de arquitetura, apoiar equipes de operação e atuar como referência em segurança Google dentro da organização.   Responsabilidades   Atuar como especialista técnico em soluções de segurança Google Cloud, liderando definições arquiteturais e boas práticas de segurança.  Projetar, implementar e evoluir ambientes de segurança utilizando as soluções nativas do Google Cloud Security.  Liderar iniciativas relacionadas a monitoramento, detecção de ameaças, resposta a incidentes e operações de segurança utilizando Google SecOps (Chronicle).  Implementar e otimizar controles de segurança para ambientes Google Cloud, Google Workspace e Chrome Enterprise.  Desenhar e implementar estratégias de proteção de dados utilizando Google Cloud DLP.  Atuar na gestão de identidade e acesso utilizando Cloud Identity e controles avançados de IAM.  Implementar e administrar soluções de Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) e Cloud Workload Protection Platform (CWPP).  Desenvolver casos de uso, correlações, playbooks e integrações para operações de segurança.  Conduzir avaliações de postura de segurança, identificação de vulnerabilidades e recomendações de melhorias.  Participar de projetos de transformação, modernização e fortalecimento da maturidade de segurança corporativa.  Atuar em conjunto com equipes de infraestrutura, cloud, compliance, governança e operações de segurança.   Inglês fluente para atuação em ambiente global.   Experiência sólida atuando como Especialista, Arquiteto ou Consultor de Segurança Google Cloud.   Experiência prática e hands-on administrando ambientes Google Cloud em produção.   Experiência com Google SecOps (Chronicle), Security Command Center e Google Cloud DLP.   Conhecimento avançado em Cloud Identity, IAM, Google Workspace Security e Chrome Enterprise.   Experiência em projetos de migração de ambientes Microsoft para soluções Google.   Experiência em arquitetura, implementação e evolução de soluções de segurança no ecossistema Google.   Experiência atuando como referência técnica, líder técnico ou principal especialista em projetos de segurança cloud.   Conhecimento em Security Operations, Incident Response e Threat Intelligence.   Experiência com CSPM, CNAPP ou CWPP para proteção de ambientes cloud.  Capacidade de atuar com múltiplos stakeholders, fornecedores e parceiros de implementação.  Certificação Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer.   Certificação Google Professional Cloud Architect.   Certificação Google Professional Security Operations Analyst.    Informações Adicionais:   Atuação 100% remota  Contratação CLT

title: Especialista em CRM e Automação de Jornadas WhatsApp
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Especialista em CRM e Automação de Jornadas WhatsApp em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Modelo de contratação Contratação PJ Home Office  Importante:  Esta vaga é destinada a profissionais que já tenham atuado diretamente na construção, implementação e otimização de jornadas de CRM via WhatsApp em larga escala. Experiências limitadas a disparos pontuais, operação básica de CRM ou execução de campanhas sem atuação estratégica não atendem ao perfil da posição. A ConCrédito é uma das empresas que mais crescem no mercado de crédito consignado e soluções financeiras digitais no Brasil. Atuamos com crédito consignado para CLT, INSS, SIAPE e antecipação do FGTS, oferecendo uma experiência simples, segura e totalmente digital aos nossos clientes. Estamos entre as 3 melhores empresas do segmento no Reclame Aqui e entre as 35 empresas de maior crescimento do país, segundo a Revista Exame. Vivemos um momento estratégico de expansão e evolução tecnológica, com forte investimento em dados, automação, inteligência operacional e experiência do cliente. Sobre a oportunidade:  Estamos em busca de um(a) Especialista em CRM com experiência comprovada em jornadas de relacionamento via WhatsApp em larga escala para liderar a evolução da nossa operação de CRM. Essa pessoa terá papel fundamental na construção da estratégia de relacionamento da empresa, conectando dados, automações, segmentações e comunicação para aumentar conversão, retenção, engajamento e eficiência operacional. Mais do que operar campanhas, buscamos alguém capaz de estruturar processos, definir boas práticas, construir governança e criar uma operação escalável de CRM orientada por dados.  Requisitos obrigatórios:  Experiência comprovada com CRM e jornadas de relacionamento via WhatsApp em larga escala. Experiência com segmentação, automação, testes, monitoramento e otimização de campanhas. Vivência na implementação ou estruturação de ferramentas de CRM, Marketing Automation ou Customer Engagement. Conhecimento sólido em SQL e análise de dados. Experiência com integrações, APIs, webhooks e automações. Conhecimento das boas práticas da WhatsApp Business Platform / Cloud API. Experiência em desenho de jornadas orientadas ao ciclo de vida do cliente. Conhecimento de métricas de CRM, experimentação e mensuração de resultados. Capacidade de atuar com áreas técnicas e de negócio. Conhecimento sobre LGPD, consentimento e governança de dados.   Responsabilidades:  Estruturar e implementar boas práticas de CRM durante a evolução da plataforma. Desenhar, implementar e otimizar jornadas de relacionamento via WhatsApp em larga escala. Criar estratégias de aquisição, ativação, nutrição, conversão, retenção, reengajamento e pós-venda. Transformar objetivos de negócio em segmentações, gatilhos, regras de elegibilidade, réguas de comunicação e indicadores. Definir e organizar a estrutura de dados necessária para suportar as jornadas. Construir segmentações e audiências utilizando dados do Snowflake. Integrar dados, automações e canais por meio do N8N, WhatsApp Cloud API e ColmeIA.cx. Definir padrões para templates, personalização, frequência de comunicação, testes A/B e governança dos disparos. Garantir boas práticas de entregabilidade e escalabilidade no WhatsApp. Desenvolver dashboards, funis e rotinas de acompanhamento de performance. Trabalhar em parceria com as áreas de Dados, Tecnologia, Growth, Comercial e Operações. Documentar processos, aprendizados, playbooks e padrões operacionais.  Indicadores sob sua responsabilidade:  Taxas de entrega, leitura, clique, resposta e conversão. Taxa de reativação de clientes. Taxa de opt-out, bloqueios e denúncias. Qualidade da conta e saúde do canal WhatsApp. Conversão por jornada, público, produto e etapa do funil. Receita gerada pelas ações de CRM. ROI das campanhas. Eficiência operacional das automações. Qualidade e confiabilidade dos dados utilizados. Resultados de testes A/B e iniciativas de otimização.  O que esperamos que você seja capaz de entregar nos primeiros 90 dias:  Diagnóstico completo da operação atual de CRM. Mapeamento das principais jornadas de WhatsApp. Estruturação das boas práticas de governança e comunicação. Definição do modelo de segmentação e gestão de dados. Implementação de dashboards e rotinas de acompanhamento. Criação de backlog de melhorias, hipóteses e automações prioritárias.  Desafio : Você será responsável por desenhar e evoluir jornadas completas de relacionamento utilizando o WhatsApp como principal canal de comunicação, atuando desde a definição da estratégia até a implementação, análise de resultados e otimização contínua. Também participará diretamente da implementação e amadurecimento da nossa estrutura de CRM, ajudando a transformar dados e oportunidades de negócio em jornadas automatizadas e mensuráveis. Stack Atual  Você atuará em um ambiente moderno, com foco em dados e automação: Snowflake para Data Warehouse e segmentações Metabase para análises e acompanhamento de indicadores N8N para integrações e automações WhatsApp Cloud API para comunicação oficial ColmeIA.cx para automação multicanal e gestão de jornadas  Perfil que buscamos:  Perfil hands-on e orientado à execução. Forte capacidade analítica. Organização e visão de processos. Senso de dono e autonomia. Capacidade de construir estruturas do zero. Facilidade para trabalhar com diferentes áreas. Visão crítica para identificar gargalos e oportunidades de melhoria. Mentalidade orientada a dados e resultados.   Diferenciais:  Experiência com Snowflake, Metabase, N8N, WhatsApp Cloud API ou ColmeIA.cx. Experiência em fintechs, crédito consignado, antecipação de FGTS ou serviços financeiros. Conhecimento em CDP, CRM Lifecycle, Customer Data Platform e automação conversacional. Experiência com IA aplicada à comunicação e atendimento. Experiência em governança de templates e escalabilidade de canais WhatsApp. Vivência com Growth, Dados, Produto, CX, Vendas ou Operações. Certificações em CRM, Analytics, SQL, Marketing Automation ou plataformas de automação.  O que você vai encontrar na concrédito:  Autonomia para construir e evoluir uma operação de CRM estratégica. Ambiente altamente orientado a dados. Contato direto com tecnologia, dados, growth e operação. Espaço para gerar impacto real no negócio. Participação ativa em um momento importante de crescimento e transformação da empresa. Time com foco em inovação, velocidade e execução.

title: Quality Assurance Automação
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Quality Assurance Automação em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

A Genesis Consulting tem oportunidade imediata para profissional especialista em Qualidade de Softwares com verdadeira paixão por crescimento profissional e entrega de valor através da tecnologia. Nossos clientes são alguns dos principais líderes mundiais em diferentes indústrias e o candidato fará parte de projetos desafiadores para construir e apoiar soluções técnicas para suas necessidades. O QA de Automação é o profissional responsável por estruturar, implementar e sustentar a automação de testes ao longo do ciclo de desenvolvimento, assegurando qualidade, rastreabilidade e velocidade nas entregas. Sua atuação vai além da execução técnica: ele contribui para a prevenção de defeitos, fortalecimento da cultura de qualidade e aumento da confiança do time nas releases. Esse papel é especialmente relevante em ambientes com entregas contínuas, múltiplas integrações e necessidade de regressão frequente, pois reduz esforço manual, aumenta a previsibilidade e melhora a estabilidade do produto. Escopo de atuação O profissional atua na definição da estratégia de testes automatizados, desenho de cenários críticos, implementação de frameworks, integração com pipelines, análise de falhas, manutenção da suíte de regressão e apoio à evolução das práticas de qualidade do time. Responsabilidades  Implementar, manter e evoluir testes automatizados para aplicações web, APIs e, quando aplicável, fluxos integrados entre sistemas. Participar da análise de requisitos, refinamentos e critérios de aceite, contribuindo com visão preventiva de qualidade desde as etapas iniciais do desenvolvimento. Definir a melhor abordagem de automação para cada contexto, equilibrando cobertura, custo de manutenção, estabilidade e retorno sobre investimento. Integrar a execução dos testes automatizados às pipelines de CI/CD, garantindo feedback rápido e confiável para o time. Estruturar e manter massa de testes, dados de apoio, mocks, stubs e evidências necessárias para execução consistente dos cenários automatizados. Monitorar falhas recorrentes, identificar causas-raiz e atuar em conjunto com desenvolvedores e demais QAs na melhoria contínua da qualidade. title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
Empresa está contratando Technical Support Engineer em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

About Theta Data  Theta Data is a pioneering data company specializing in low-latency APIs for delivering high-speed options and stocks data. Our mission is to empower users with real-time, actionable information to make well-informed decisions in dynamic financial markets. With a focus on speed and broad data coverage, Theta Data stands at the forefront of the options data industry by providing essential tools and insights. We are dedicated to equipping professionals with the resources needed to excel in a competitive landscape. We’re a small, nimble team growing quickly. Our platform handles billions of database requests daily, and we’re just getting started. The complexity of our data problems is real: tick-level options data is among the most intricate financial data to store, index, and serve at scale. We take engineering seriously. The Role  We're hiring a Technical Support Engineer to be the front line of the customer experience at Theta Data. This is not a generic helpdesk role. Our customers are quantitative researchers, developers, and traders who ask technically sophisticated questions about financial data, APIs, and data integrity. You'll need to understand what they're asking and diagnose problems in depth. Your primary responsibility is to monitor Intercom and Discord to identify, triage, and respond to customer issues as they come in. When you can resolve an issue or provide a working workaround, you do it. When you can't, write a clear, well-documented Jira ticket and escalate to Engineering with everything they need to act quickly, and track the ticket's progress until it's complete. We believe the most important feature is the one the customer already paid for. We take this promise seriously, and we want someone who will, too! What You'll Do  Monitor Intercom and Discord and respond to incoming customer issues in a timely manner Diagnose technical problems related to API behavior, data quality, authentication, request handling, and account set-up Write and run Python scripts to reproduce issues and validate data against expected behavior Make REST API calls to investigate and isolate bugs or unexpected responses Provide workarounds and clear guidance to customers where possible Write thorough, reproducible Jira tickets and escalate unresolved issues Identify recurring issues and surface patterns to help prioritize fixes Create and maintain internal documentation on common issues, workarounds, and resolution steps  What We're Looking For  Required  Experience working in a technical support or customer-facing engineering role Comfort working with REST APIs, including reading documentation, making requests, and interpreting responses Working knowledge of Python for scripting, data inspection, and reproducing issues Strong written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly to both customers and engineers Detail-oriented and systematic approach to diagnosing problems Weekend support rotation  Nice to Have  Prior experience with financial data APIs Familiarity with financial data concepts (options, equities, market data, OHLCV, Greeks, etc.) Familiarity with Jira or similar issue tracking tools Experience with Intercom or similar support platforms Exposure to SQL or database queries for data validation  Why Theta Data  Rapid growth: the platform and team are both scaling fast Real challenges: data at scale, low-latency systems, complex financial data High ownership: a small team means your decisions matter; you will influence how we operate Remote-first: work from anywhere Direct impact: your work reaches thousands of quants and researchers daily A role that rewards genuine curiosity about financial data and technical problem-solving

You'll work close to the data, turning messy enterprise sources into features, models, and AI-powered applications that run reliably in production rather than living in a notebook. The client is a data and AI platform company that modernizes how energy and heavy-industry enterprises work with their data, migrating legacy systems onto Databricks and the lakehouse and then building intelligence on top of it. The work is hands-on and full-lifecycle: you'll touch pipelines, models, and the services that put predictions in front of real users. This role suits someone who likes living at the seam between data engineering and ML. If you've shipped models that depend on real pipelines holding up, and you want to do that work on a clean Databricks stack instead of fighting infrastructure, you'll feel at home here. What You'll Do  Build, train, and validate ML models on Databricks, with real attention to evaluation, generalization, and where the model will actually be used Engineer features and data transformations in Spark and SQL from enterprise sources that are rarely tidy Stand up MLflow-based workflows for experiment tracking, model registry, and reproducible training runs Deploy models as batch jobs or real-time endpoints, then keep them honest with monitoring for drift, latency, and cost Partner with data engineers on the lakehouse layer so the data feeding your models is reliable and well-modeled Bring LLM and retrieval techniques into the mix where they fit the problem, and skip them where they don't Apply solid engineering habits throughout: version control, testing, code review, CI/CD  Qualifications  3 to 5+ years building ML or AI systems in production, with strong Python fundamentals Hands-on experience with Databricks, including Spark and Delta Lake (Azure Databricks is a plus) Comfort across the ML lifecycle: feature engineering, training, validation, deployment, and monitoring Working knowledge of MLflow or a comparable experiment tracking and model registry tool Strong SQL and a real understanding of how data pipelines feed models Exposure to LLM-powered or retrieval-based applications, or genuine curiosity to grow into them Professional working English, since collaboration happens across a distributed team  Why Join Us  You'll join a small, senior team that has been steadily building out a Databricks-based platform for demanding enterprise clients, where the data is complex and the standards for what ships are high. The work is remote and async-friendly, and your models won't sit on a shelf; they go into systems people actually depend on. If you want ownership over real ML work on a clean, modern stack, with teammates who care about doing it right, this is a strong fit. title: Emerging Market Trader
description:

Role Overview  We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African/LATAM/Asian currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties. Key Responsibilities  FX Trading & Liquidity Management Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS), LATAM (ARS, BRL, MXN) and/or Asian (IDR, VDN, etc.)  on markets. Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks  across relevant regions. Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades  to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure. Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics  across EM FX markets.  Hedging Strategy & Risk Management Design and implement FX hedging strategies  to manage corporate or client-driven exposures. Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools  where relevant. Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization . Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.  Trading Infrastructure & Systems Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including: Automated hedging engines  Liquidity aggregation systems Smart order routing Pricing and risk management tools Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers  via APIs or FIX protocols. Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring .  Market Development Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners  across emerging markets. Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs  and support new corridor launches. Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure  supporting global payments and settlement flows.  Requirements  Experience 5–10+ years of FX trading experience  in Emerging Markets. Strong experience trading African currencies , such as: Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP Experience working at: Global banks EM FX trading firms Payment / fintech companies Crypto exchanges or market makers Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades .  Technical Expertise Deep understanding of: FX market microstructure in illiquid markets  NDF markets and offshore hedging  Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks  Hands-on experience building or optimizing: FX trading systems  Hedging engines  Liquidity aggregation platforms  Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution .  Skills Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities. Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments . Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks . Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.  Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations . Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources . Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies . Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations . Strong analytical and problem solving skills Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments  Vision & Mission  OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Gastroenterologia!  Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando. *SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: * A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas. *O QUE PROCURAMOS: * Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Gastroenterologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos; PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES  Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em gastroenterologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.  Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais.  Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anamneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações do sistema gastrointestinal à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais, endoscópicos e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em gastroenterologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.  Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.  Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.  Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças gastrointestinais.  Recomendar alterações no estilo de vida, dieta e hábitos alimentares para melhorar a saúde digestiva.  Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.  Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.  Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.  Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde gastrointestinais.  Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.  Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.  Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.  Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.  Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.  Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.  Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.  REQUISITOS   Formação Acadêmica:   Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA CONCLUÍDA (ou em andamento) OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO/PÓS EM GASTROENTEROLOGIA (CLÍNICA OU CIRÚRGICA).  Certificações:   Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM); Certificado de Título de Especialista em Gastroenterologia - RQE (Emitido pelo Conselho); ou comprovante de matrícula em Residência médica. Pós ou Especialização na área; Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);  Experiência:   Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em gastroenterologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde; Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico na Atenção Primária à Saúde;  Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:   Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais. Competências Comportamentais:  Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional. Outros Requisitos Importantes:   Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável. title: Lead Product Designer
description:
Empresa está contratando Lead Product Designer em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Who are we?  Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Romania, Poland, Ukraine, and Brazil, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life. Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past four years and plans to continue growing. About the role  This is a senior, consultancy-style design role. You'll move between leading projects end-to-end — driving discovery, aligning stakeholders, shaping direction — and rolling up your sleeves as a senior-level individual contributor when that's what the work needs. You'll be working on mature, live products where the bar is improving what exists: smoothing workflows, sharpening hierarchy, lifting conversion, and removing friction. This is not a greenfield, portfolio-piece role. If you get satisfaction from making a working product noticeably better for the people who use it every day, you'll like it here. Key responsibilities  Take ownership of design problems on assigned projects — frame the problem, drive it through discovery, design, and delivery, and bring stakeholders along the whole way. Lead or contribute on a project depending on what's needed — sometimes you're directing the design effort, sometimes you're the one in Figma producing the work. Both modes should feel comfortable. Partner closely with product managers and engineers, translating ambiguous requirements into concrete, testable design solutions and iterating against live implementations. Run the iterative cycle from low-fidelity exploration through high-fidelity delivery, with usability validation at the points where it actually changes the outcome. Facilitate workshops, design reviews, and working sessions with cross-functional and executive stakeholders. Make decisions visible and trade-offs explicit. Mentor and raise the bar for designers around you. Build durable relationships with stakeholders. Understand what they're actually trying to achieve and push back constructively when the brief is wrong.  Must haves  6–10+ years of UX/Product Design experience, ideally including time in a consultancy, agency, or embedded-team setting where you've owned client or stakeholder relationships directly. Demonstrated ability to flex between leading a project (or a small team) and contributing as a senior IC, depending on what the engagement needs. Track record of improving existing products rather than designing greenfield experiences — measurable wins on usability, conversion, or workflow efficiency. Strong visual and UI judgment for forms, workflows, CTAs, hierarchy, and layout. You can defend a layout decision on the merits. Comfort working closely with engineering against live implementations — you can read a real interface and tell us what's wrong with it before opening Figma. Ability to articulate why a design decision was made and what problem it solves, to audiences ranging from engineers to executives. Experience facilitating cross-functional workshops and leading business reviews or strategic planning sessions with senior stakeholders.  Nice to have  Background designing for regulated or enterprise domains (finance, compliance, GRC, banking, or similar). Experience designing software embedded inside third-party platforms. Familiarity with mature component libraries and design systems (MUI or similar). Experience mentoring or leveling up other designers through example and critique. Working knowledge of HTML/CSS; JavaScript a plus. Degree in Design, HCI, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent experience.

title: Professor de francês
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Professor de francês em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!   Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!  A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada. Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.  Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco.  Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível. *Esta não é uma vaga CLT*  O que oferecemos?  Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos  de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados . Mentorias semanais  com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataforma exclusiva  para acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.  Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?  Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.  Necessário:  Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais  para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.  O diferencial?  Aqui você é mais que um professor.  Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos. Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora. Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas. Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii  com certeza é o seu lugar. Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas.  Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos! O que eu faço?  Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as  Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio. QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?  Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.  Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores. Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
Empresa está contratando Technical Project Manager em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

About the Company Fraud Deflect helps businesses make better decisions around fraud, chargebacks, disputes, alerts, and operational performance. We work with high-volume operational data and need clear, trusted reporting that helps teams move quickly and make better decisions. About the Role  The Technical Project Manager will work closely with engineering and collaborate with client experience, operations, and leadership to manage technical projects from planning through completion. This person should be organized, clear, and comfortable working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. This is not a purely administrative project management role. The right person should understand enough about software, APIs, data, incident management, change management, and technical dependencies to ask good questions, spot blockers, and help teams stay aligned. Familiarity with ITIL practices is important, especially around incident management, change management, service management, problem management, and continuous improvement. Responsibilities  Manage technical projects across engineering, product, and operations. Help define project scope, timelines, milestones, owners, and priorities. Track progress and make sure work is moving forward. Identify blockers, risks, and dependencies early. Keep stakeholders updated on status, changes, and next steps. Coordinate technical work involving APIs, data, internal tools, customer workflows, IT systems, and integrations. Help organize Jira tickets, documentation, meeting notes, and follow-ups. Make sure decisions, requirements, and action items are clearly documented. Support launch planning, testing coordination, and rollout communication. Support incident follow-ups, change coordination, and post-implementation reviews. Help improve lightweight processes around service delivery, technical operations, and project execution. Improve processes that help the team move faster without adding unnecessary overhead.  Qualifications  5+ years of experience in technical project management, project management, product operations, engineering operations, engineering project management, or a similar role. Experience working with software engineering teams. Familiarity with ITIL practices, including incident management, change management, problem management, service management, and continuous improvement. Strong understanding of basic technical concepts such as APIs, databases, integrations, cloud systems, IT systems, and production releases. Strong communication and organization skills. Ability to manage multiple projects at the same time. Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with changing priorities. Able to turn unclear problems into clear next steps. Experience using tools like Jira Software, Confluence, Slack, GitHub, Jira Service Management, or similar platforms.  Required Skills  ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent practical experience. Experience in fintech, payments, fraud prevention, chargebacks, banking, or risk. Experience working on customer integrations or partner integrations. Basic SQL knowledge. Experience working at a startup or small fast-moving company. Familiarity with compliance, reporting, audits, service management, or operational workflows.  What Success Looks Like  Projects have clear owners, timelines, and next steps. Engineering has fewer interruptions caused by unclear requirements or missing coordination. Leadership has better visibility into what is being worked on, what is blocked, and what needs a decision. Teams are aligned before launches, production changes, and major operational updates. Incidents, changes, and follow-up actions are tracked clearly. Work gets delivered more consistently without adding unnecessary process.  Ideal Candidate  The ideal candidate is organized, technical enough to understand engineering and IT discussions, and practical enough to keep things moving. They should be able to communicate clearly, follow up consistently, and help bring structure to fast-moving projects without slowing the team down.

title: Full Stack Engineer (Python/React/AI tools)
description:
Empresa está contratando Full Stack Engineer (Python/React/AI tools) em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

About Us  YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments. Our engineering team builds agentic solutions that data and research teams utilize to transform petabytes of raw data into strategic intelligence. Our resulting product delivers accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers — ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies — depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture — recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years — emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.  What It’s Like to Work at YipitData  YipitData isn’t a place for coasting — it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers. Ownership That Matters:  You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes Rapid Growth:  We compress years of learning into months Merit Over Titles:  Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure Velocity with Purpose:  We move fast, support each other, and aim high — always with purpose and intention   About The Role  We’re looking for a seasoned, high-output engineer who can develop our rapidly growing agent platform for our Revenue organization. This individual will sit on our Infrastructure team that builds AI-native solutions used by the entire company to find, convert, and better enable customers with the products we launch. The ideal candidate possesses 3+ years of architecting and developing full-stack applications, proficient data analytics skills, strong interest in agentic workflows, and 5+ years working on applications or codebases built with Python, Databricks, React/JavaScript/TypeScript, and AWS. You’ll be responsible for production-grade systems that our customers and internal teams depend on daily. That means being responsive, reliable, and an excellent communicator — both when things are going well and especially when they’re not. The ideal candidate treats AI coding tools as core infrastructure for how they work — not a novelty. You’ve shipped full-stack applications, you’re comfortable navigating ambiguity, and you are customer-obsessed in your approach to improving software.  As a Senior Software Engineer, You Will  Own features and systems end-to-end across multiple product surfaces — architecture, implementation, deployment, and iteration Architect and deliver solutions for our Revenue, Revenue Operations, and Business Development teams – including data tools, applications, and agentic orchestrators Serve as a subject matter expert across the whole stack, and report directly to the Chief Architect, who will provide hands-on mentorship in cutting‑edge AI-native development, big data analytics, and cloud infrastructure. Collaborate closely with the Revenue organization, discovering opportunities, projects, and areas to revamp critical business processes with AI Drive initiatives across teams — you’re not waiting for a PM to write a spec; you’re in the room shaping what gets built and why Leverage AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex to improve personal productivity, ship trustworthy solutions faster through harness engineering, code quality, and documentation. Produce clear documentation: create playbooks, docs, and training materials to institutionalize best practices.   You Are Likely To Succeed If  You have 5+ years of hands-on software development experience with a proven track record of shipping customer-facing applications — and the impact to show for it You are stack-flexible: comfortable working across Python, TypeScript/React, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Databricks). You learn new tools fast and don’t let unfamiliar tech slow you down You have an AI-accelerated workflow — you actively use AI coding tools  to ship faster, not as an experiment, but as how you work every day You thrive in ambiguity — you can take a vague business problem, break it down, and deliver a working solution without heavy-handed direction You are a strong communicator who can work directly with non-technical stakeholders, translate between business needs and engineering tradeoffs, and drive alignment You are responsive and reliable — you take ownership of production systems and communicate proactively, especially under pressure You have a bias toward action and ownership — you see a problem, you fix it; you see an opportunity, you ship it You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, STEM, or a related technical discipline Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher)   What We Offer:  Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings. Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more! Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. Personal laptop Health and wellness package  Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.  We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

Role Overview  We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties. Key Responsibilities  FX Trading & Liquidity Management Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS)  or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS)  markets. Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks  across relevant regions. Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades  to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure. Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics  across EM FX markets.  Hedging Strategy & Risk Management Design and implement FX hedging strategies  to manage corporate or client-driven exposures. Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools  where relevant. Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization . Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.  Trading Infrastructure & Systems Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including: Automated hedging engines  Liquidity aggregation systems Smart order routing Pricing and risk management tools Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers  via APIs or FIX protocols. Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring .  Market Development Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners  across emerging markets. Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs  and support new corridor launches. Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure  supporting global payments and settlement flows.  Requirements  Experience 5–10+ years of FX trading experience  in Emerging Markets. Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies , such as: Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS Experience working at: Global banks EM FX trading firms Payment / fintech companies Crypto exchanges or market makers Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades .  Technical Expertise Deep understanding of: FX market microstructure in illiquid markets  NDF markets and offshore hedging  Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks  Hands-on experience building or optimizing: FX trading systems  Hedging engines  Liquidity aggregation platforms  Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution .  Skills Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities. Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments . Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks . Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.  Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations . Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources . Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies . Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations . Strong analytical and problem solving skills Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments  Vision & Mission  OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

O período de experiência inclui o recebimento de comissões, e há dois dias de folga aos finais de semana. Requisitos e Habilidades:  1. Graduação (nível superior) ou formação acadêmica superior; a área de formação é flexível (preferência para cursos em Engenharia Eletrônica ou Marketing). 2. Boas habilidades de comunicação, coordenação e execução; capacidade de resposta rápida e perspicaz; forte senso de responsabilidade. 4. Experiência em técnicas e estratégias de vendas, incluindo habilidades de apresentação e negociação. 5. Forte capacidade de aprendizado e espírito de busca por aprendizado contínuo. 6. Aspiração em atuar e paixão pelo setor de comércio exterior e e-commerce. 7. Bom espírito de equipe.

Requisitos técnicos obrigatórios:  ● Experiência prática com CRO, Experimentação, otimização de conversão ou performance digital em empresa, agência ou consultoria. ● Experiência com testes A/B, personalização e ferramentas de experimentação. ● Boa base em copywriting aplicado à conversão. ● Conhecimento em UX, com visão crítica sobre interfaces, jornadas, fluxos e experiência do usuário. ● Familiaridade com ferramentas de analytics, métricas, dashboards, funis e leitura de dados. ● Familiaridade com ferramentas de mapas de calor, gravações de sessão e análise de comportamento do usuário. ● Capacidade de olhar para resultados de negócio, e não apenas melhorias genéricas de experiência. ● Uso recorrente de ferramentas de IA no dia a dia de trabalho. ● Vivência prática com Figma. ● Boa comunicação verbal para conduzir reuniões, apresentar análises e interagir com diferentes perfis e stakeholders. ● Organização, autonomia e senso de responsabilidade para atuar bem em um contexto 100% remoto. ● Perfil investigativo, analítico e com vontade real de crescer em CRO e Experimentação. Diferenciais desejáveis:  ● Conhecimento em acessibilidade web, HTML semântico e hierarquia de páginas. ● Repertório em análise de funis, proposta de valor e argumentação de conversão. ● Interesse constante por tendências de CRO, UX, Growth e Inteligência Artificial. ● Experiência atuando simultaneamente em múltiplos projetos e clientes.
