The Role  As a Strategic Customer Success Manager, you will serve as a trusted advisor to mid-sized to large enterprise accounts. You will build deep relationships, drive adoption of our AI-powered platform, maximize value, and fuel retention and expansion. You will collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Support to ensure customers achieve their business goals through clear communication and proactive guidance. Why Join Our Customer Success Team  This is a strategic, high-impact role where you will own complex accounts, strengthen multi-threaded relationships, and deliver measurable outcomes (NRR, expansion revenue, AI feature adoption). You will work in a collaborative, innovative global environment, partnering with diverse teams to solve real customer challenges and contribute to Sisense’s growth in embedded AI analytics. About You  You thrive in fast-paced, evolving environments, adapting quickly while staying positive and solution-focused. You are a natural relationship builder, skilled at nurturing trusted, multi-level partnerships and positioning yourself as a key advisor. You quickly grasp business goals and technical concepts (including AI/analytics platforms) to align solutions with customer needs. You are proactive and consultative, identifying opportunities, anticipating challenges, and advocating for customers while balancing business priorities. You are collaborative, open to feedback, and passionate about delivering results through continuous learning.  Requirements  3–5 years as a Customer Success Manager (or equivalent), with proven success managing enterprise/mid-market accounts (SaaS/BI/analytics preferred). Strong track record driving product adoption, value realization, NRR, and revenue expansion. Excellent presentation and executive communication skills; experience leading EBRs/QBRs and building C-level relationships. Ability to own full account planning, health monitoring, and success strategy across a portfolio. Proactive mindset: identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities, mitigate risks, and deliver measurable ROI. Project management skills to handle complex implementations, onboarding, and technical discussions. Experience collaborating cross-functionally (Sales, Product, Engineering) to resolve issues and influence roadmaps. Exceptional interpersonal, listening, written, and verbal skills (fluent English required; Portuguese a plus). Results-driven with critical thinking, problem-solving, and a customer-centric focus. Comfortable in a dynamic, remote environment managing multiple priorities. Bonus: Background in Business Intelligence (BI), embedded analytics, AI/GenAI enablement, or similar technical solutions.  How You’ll Ramp  By Day 30  Complete Customer Success onboarding and training (Sisense values, culture, relationship techniques, product overview, competition, and transformational outcomes). Begin meeting customers, shadowing QBRs/EBRs, and observing how we build relationships and deliver value.  By Day 60  Develop strategic account plans for your portfolio and start driving opportunities (adoption, expansion, renewals). Deepen product/technical knowledge through coaching and hands-on work. Fully embed with your accounts and collaborate side-by-side with the team.  By Day 90  Own your book of business end-to-end, driving partnership success and measurable results (NRR, adoption, expansion). Master Customer Success best practices, including onboarding, proactive risk management, and AI feature enablement. Become a key contributor to the team’s revenue retention and growth goals.  What We Offer  Employment through a partner agency (B2B). Competitive base salary up to USD 3,500 per month (depending on experience). Eligibility for a quarterly performance bonus. Opportunity to work with a global leader in AI-powered embedded analytics. Flexible remote work with a collaborative international team. Professional development and growth opportunities within Customer Success.

Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas. *O QUE PROCURAMOS: * Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Nefrologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos. *PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES*  Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Nefrologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.   Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos.  Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anmneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em Nefrologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.  Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais da especialidade Nefrologia através de videochamadas.  Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.  Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.  Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças nefrológicas.  Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.  Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.  Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.   Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde em Nefrologia.  Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.  Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.  Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.  Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.  Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.   Manter-se bem informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.  Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.   REQUISITOS  Formação Acadêmica:  Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA CONCLUÍDA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO/PÓS EM NEFROLOGIA.  Certificações:  Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM); Certificado de Título de Especialista em Nefrologia - RQE  (Emitido pelo Conselho do respectivo Estado); Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);  Experiência:   Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Nefrologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina. Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:   Competência em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos. Competências Comportamentais:  Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional. Outros Requisitos Importantes:   Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável. Local de Trabalho:  REMOTO Remuneração e Agendamentos: a combinar durante processo seletivo. IMPORTANTE:  MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO:  Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo, bem como possuir CRM do respectivo CNPJ ativo. Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Gastroenterologista.

Our work spans brand identity, campaign development, design systems, web design, presentations, marketing assets, video, motion, 3D animation, AI-powered production, and creative leadership. We work with companies that need a creative partner who can bring clarity, consistency, and structure to sophisticated products. Our clients have included technology, AI, SaaS, gaming, entertainment, and consumer electronics brands, with representative work across companies and projects in various tech-driven spaces.  About the RoleThe Project Manager will be responsible for helping Ten16 plan, coordinate, and deliver creative projects from kickoff through final delivery. This person will work closely with creative directors, designers, producers, writers, motion teams, developers, and clients to make sure everyone understands what needs to happen, when it needs to happen, and what is required to deliver excellent work. This role is ideal for someone who has already worked in an agency, creative studio, production company, marketing team, or digital product environment and understands how creative work moves from brief to execution. The role does not require senior-level account leadership, but it does require organization, fluent English and Portuguese communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.  You will manage active project timelines and ensure that milestones, deliverables, meetings, and reviews are clearly documented and communicated. You will help turn creative scopes into practical schedules, making sure that internal team members understand priorities and that clients understand what is needed from them to keep projects moving. You will coordinate daily and weekly project activity across brand, design, web, video, motion, campaign, and presentation work. This includes assigning or tracking tasks, following up on open items, preparing meeting agendas, documenting decisions, and making sure feedback is captured accurately. You will also help maintain project management tools, shared folders, project boards, calendars, and production documents so the team always has a reliable source of truth. You will support client-facing communication in English with professionalism and clarity. This may include sending status updates, recapping meetings, organizing feedback, preparing for presentations, and helping the team stay ahead of deadlines. Because Ten16 works with technology-driven companies, you should be comfortable working on projects where the subject matter may be complex, technical, or still evolving. You will help protect the quality of the work by making sure deliverables are complete, organized, properly labeled, and ready for review or delivery. You will not be expected to creative-direct the work, but you should have a strong eye for detail and enough creative production experience to recognize when something is missing, unclear, or not ready to send. QualificationsThe ideal candidate has approximately 3–5 years of experience in project management, creative production, account coordination, marketing operations, agency operations, or a related role. They should have experience managing creative deliverables and coordinating cross-functional teams in a remote environment. They must be located in Brazil and must be fluent in both Portuguese and English. English fluency is essential because the role will involve written and spoken communication with U.S.-based team members and clients. Portuguese fluency is equally important for collaboration with Brazil-based team members and vendors.

title: Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Contract Type:  Fixed-Term Contract (Maternity Leave Cover) Duration:  6 months initially, with potential extension to 9 months. About the Role  We are seeking a Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn  to join our Customer organisation. Reporting to the RevOps Senior Manager - Customer, this role will lead the reporting, analysis, and process evolution of churn performance as the business scales across multiple business units. This is a highly visible analytical role responsible for ensuring customer churn, revenue impact, retention activity, and related operational metrics are reported accurately, consistently, and with clear business insight. You will partner closely with Renewals, Customer Success, Finance, RevOps, and senior leadership to turn churn data into actionable commentary and decisions. The role will strengthen Salesforce and related reporting processes as reliable systems of record, while continuously improving the cadence, quality, and efficiency of churn reporting across the organisation. Key Responsibilities  Churn Reporting & Revenue Impact  Own reporting of customer churn and associated revenue impact across all business units. Ensure accuracy across multiple methodologies, reconcile results where required, and translate the numbers into a clear story that can be understood and acted on by senior leaders. Retention Analysis & Insight  Analyse the customer(churn pipeline and build reporting that delivers insight into retention initiatives, discount usage, save rates, customer contact rates, customer health status, and other leading or lagging indicators of churn risk. Process Standardisation & Continuous Improvement  Drive standardisation and evolution of churn reporting processes as systems, definitions, and business processes mature. Proactively identify opportunities to improve the reporting cycle, increase efficiency, reduce manual effort, and enhance the quality of insight month over month. Salesforce Data Quality & Governance  Strengthen Salesforce as a system of record by validating data, identifying reporting exceptions, and partnering with Renewals, RevOps, Finance, and Revenue Technology stakeholders to ensure dashboards are accurate and items that are not true churn are not reported as churn. Monthly Business Review Preparation & Presentation  Prepare materials, briefing documents, and commentary for monthly business reviews. Deep dive into reported numbers, explain key movements and drivers, present insights to senior leaders including the CFO and CCO, respond to queries, track actions, and evolve the reporting process.  Required Qualifications & Experience  Technical & Operational Expertise  Strong experience in an analytical, finance, revenue operations, customer operations, or similar data-driven role. Bachelor's degree minimum, ideally in Economics, Finance, Business, Data Analytics, or a related field. Strong working knowledge of Salesforce, particularly opportunity management, renewal and churn data, reporting structures, and data flows that impact customer and revenue reporting. High proficiency in Excel, with the ability to manage complex calculations, reconcile datasets, investigate variances, and build structured reporting outputs. Experience with BI or reporting tools such as Power BI is advantageous.  Revenue & Churn Acumen  Experience working with finance and revenue data, including the concepts of annual recurring revenue (ARR) and contracted annual recurring revenue (CARR) in a subscription or SaaS business. Ability to connect churn revenue metrics to retention activity, customer health indicators, and operational performance metrics. Strong analytical judgement, with the ability to double click into results, identify root causes, and explain whether movements are driven by data quality, process, customer behaviour, commercial actions, or broader business trends. Understanding of customer lifecycle, renewals, retention, and churn management processes is highly desirable.  Leadership & Stakeholder Management  Competent and confident presenting to, influencing, and constructively challenging senior stakeholders. Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working across multiple stakeholders in a global organisation. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to turn complex data into clear insight, concise commentary, and practical recommendations. Proactive, curious, and comfortable operating in an evolving environment where processes, systems, and definitions continue to mature.   Why This Role Matters  Customer health and recurring revenue are central to a growth business. This role ensures the organisation has accurate, consistent, and insightful visibility of churn and retention performance, helping leaders identify early warning signals, understand the impact of retention initiatives, and take action to protect material revenue. As the company scales, the Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn will play a key role in strengthening the reporting foundation, improving Salesforce data quality, and enabling better decisions that support customer satisfaction, renewal outcomes, and sustainable growth.

CloudSEK, one of India’s most trusted Cyber security product companies, is on a mission to build the world’s fastest and most reliable AI technology that identifies and resolves digital threats in real-time. The central proposition is leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to create a quick and reliable analysis and alert system that provides rapid detection across multiple internet sources, precise threat analysis, and prompt resolution with minimal human intervention. Founded in 2015, headquartered at Singapore, we are proud to say that we’ve grown at a frenetic pace and have been able to achieve some accolades along the way, including: CloudSEK’s Product Suite:  CloudSEK XVigil constantly maps a customer’s digital assets, identifies threats and enriches them with cyber intelligence, and then provides workflows to manage and remediate all identified threats including takedown support. A powerful Attack Surface Monitoring tool that gives visibility and intelligence on customers’ attack surfaces. CloudSEK's BeVigil uses a combination of Mobile, Web, Network and Encryption Scanners to map and protect known and unknown assets. CloudSEK’s Contextual AI SVigil identifies software supply chain risks by monitoring Software, Cloud Services, and third-party dependencies. Key Milestones:  2016: Launched our first product. 2018: Secured Pre-series A funding. 2019: Expanded operations to India, Southeast Asia, and the Americas. 2020: Won the NASSCOM-DSCI Excellence Award for Security Product Company of the Year. 2021: Raised $7M in Series A funding led by MassMutual Ventures. Awards & Recognition: Won NetApp Excellerator's \"Best Growth Strategy Award,\" CloudSEK XVigil joined NVIDIA Inception Program, and won the NASSCOM Emerge 50 Cybersecurity Award. 2025: Secured $19 million in funding led by Tenacity Ventures, Commvault. Your role will involve deep engagement with clients , providing expert guidance on threat management, and ensuring seamless integration and utilization of CloudSEK’s products . Your background in cybersecurity will be crucial in understanding and addressing the specific needs and challenges faced by our clients. Key Responsibilities:  Account Management:  Manage and nurture relationships for a client accounts, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and retention. Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and Annual Business Reviews (ABRs) to assess and enhance customer engagement. Visit customers twice a year to strengthen relationships and understand their evolving needs.  Cybersecurity Expertise:  Provide expert guidance on threat intelligence, data leak prevention, and other cybersecurity issues. Act as a security analyst, offering insights and recommendations based on threats generated by CloudSEK’s platform. Collaborate with customer security teams to ensure optimal usage of CloudSEK’s solutions.  Customer Engagement:  Develop and execute customer engagement strategies to build strong relationships with key stakeholders, including CXOs and CISOs. Foster customer champions within client organizations to drive advocacy and referrals. Generate and share client-specific quality reports, gathering feedback to continuously improve service delivery.  Revenue Generation and Retention:  Identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling CloudSEK’s products and services. Ensure on-time renewals and maintain a high customer retention rate. Source referrals and participate in revenue generation activities.  Product Usage and Feedback:  Ensure 100% product usage for features subscribed by the customers. Conduct configuration reviews and provide recommendations for product enhancements. Gather and analyze customer feedback to contribute to product development and improvement.  Operational Excellence:  Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and activities in CRM systems. Contribute to the team by sharing knowledge, conducting training sessions, and writing internal articles.  Ideal candidate:   4-5 years of experience in Cybersecurity & Client-facing experience, or a related role in the cybersecurity industry.  Strong understanding of cybersecurity principles, threat intelligence, and digital risk management.  Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships with clients. Strong language proficiency over English and Portuguese is required.  Proven track record of achieving customer success goals and driving revenue growth.  Ability to work independently and manage multiple accounts  simultaneously.  Cookie points if you have experience in the below skills:  Business reviews: Onsite meetings Maintaining NRR and GRR Threat analysis and Value delivery  Benefits of Joining CloudSEK:   We provide an environment where you can develop and enhance your skills while delivering meaningful work that matters. You’ll be rewarded a competitive salary as well as a full spectrum of generous perks and incentives which include: Flexible working hours. Food, unlimited snacks and drinks are all available while at office. And, the finest part is yet to come! Every now and then we ensure to unwind and have a good time together, which involves games, fun, and soulful music. Feel free to show off your artistic side here! CloudSEK is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

About the Company  We are a leading digital asset platform that provides trading, brokerage, custody, and infrastructure solutions for institutional and professional investors. As the business continues to grow, they are seeking an experienced liquidity professional to lead and enhance their global liquidity capabilities. Role Overview  This leadership role is responsible for overseeing liquidity strategy across digital asset and FX markets in LATAM, ensuring efficient market access, strong execution quality, and robust liquidity coverage across trading products. The successful candidate will work closely with Trading, Sales, Product, Risk, Compliance, Treasury, and Technology teams to support the firm's institutional trading business. Requirements  Significant experience in liquidity management, electronic trading, FX trading, market structure, market making, brokerage, or institutional trading environments. Experience sourcing, evaluating, and managing relationships with liquidity providers, brokers, market makers, exchanges, and banking partners. Strong understanding of FX and/or digital asset liquidity ecosystems and execution practices. Ability to analyze execution quality, transaction costs, and liquidity performance metrics. Commercially minded with strong negotiation and stakeholder management skills. Experience working within regulated financial services environments. Excellent communication, leadership, and relationship management capabilities.

title: Product Owner
description:

We are looking for a remote, full-time Product Owner  with 3-5 years of product owner or technical product manager experience. In this role, you will bridge the client needs and technical execution, managing both high-touch, custom audience requests and the development of the client's syndicated audience products. As the Product Owner, you must be strategic and detail-oriented as you lead the end-to-end product lifecycle. You will own the \"how\" and \"when\" of our audience delivery, collaborating closely with Data Science, Engineering, and Client Success teams to ensure every segment release is built to specification, rigorously QA'd, and delivered on schedule. If you are a self-starter who enjoys a fast-paced, dynamic, and autonomous environment and thrives in challenging situations, Collage is the place for you. You will be at the heart of our data engine, directly impacting how our clients understand and reach their customers. This is a high-visibility role where your ability to streamline processes and ensure data integrity will be a key driver of the company's growth. Our client unleashes the power of culture, driving brand growth with consumer insights, analytics, tools, and best practices for over 250 iconic U.S. brands. Its solutions are fueled by its cultural intelligence platform, which allows its customers to more effectively and efficiently understand, reach, and engage consumers while the U.S. undergoes significant demographic shifts. Brands build cultural fluency to activate consumers across race, ethnicity, generations, gender, and sexual identity. Our client comprises creative, analytical, diverse, hardworking, and fun individuals with an insatiable curiosity for the new collage of behaviors and patterns driving consumers today. The possibilities of the moment and opportunity to help organizations unlock their cultural capacity inspire them to seek out predictive insights and brand impacts that are unique to their model. Responsibilities  End-to-End Delivery:  Own the scoping, building, QA, and release phases for all custom and syndicated audience segments Cross-Functional Leadership:  Act as the primary point of contact between stakeholders and the Data Science team responsible for building audiences to translate complex marketing requirements into technical roadmaps Backlog Management:  Prioritize the audience creation queue, balancing urgent custom requests from enterprise clients with long-term product goals, including audience pipeline improvements Quality Assurance:  Develop and oversee rigorous QA protocols to ensure audience accuracy before release Process Optimization:  Continuously refine the audience build workflow to reduce \"time-to-market\" for new segments Market Insight:  Stay ahead of trends in MarTech and identity resolution to ensure Collage's segmentation capabilities remain best-in-class  Required Experience  Communication Skills : Excellent English communication skills Proven PO Experience :3–5 years of professional experience in a Product Owner or Technical Product Manager role, specifically within an Agile environment MarTech Experience : A deep understanding of the marketing technology ecosystem , specifically regarding audience segmentation, DMPs, CDPs, or programmatic advertising Agile Software:  Proficiency in Jira, Monday.com, or Azure DevOps for backlog grooming and sprint planning Data Literacy:  Ability to speak \"data\"—comfortable discussing SQL, data schemas, or statistical confidence with technical peers Data Science Collaboration : A track record of successfully managing projects that involve complex data modeling, large datasets, and collaboration with data scientists Project Precision : Demonstrated ability to manage multiple high-stakes projects simultaneously without losing sight of the \"fine print\" during the QA process Stakeholder Influence : Experience navigating the needs of both commercial/sales teams and technical engineering teams to find the optimal path forward High Impact Delivery : Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment Soft Skills : Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent  Desired Experience  Marketing Platforms:  Familiarity with how audiences are activated in platforms like LiveRamp, Trade Desk, or Facebook Manager  Additional Information  Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big! You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions Work with smart and creative people Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent! We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you! 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays Start: ASAP  About Velozient  We are a rapidly growing, nearshore company providing expert Latin American resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer expert talent that enjoys taking on challenging work, wants to grow their skills and experiences, and excels in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class, remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

Familiarity with BI tools (Power BI, Tableau) is an advantage. Understanding of governance methodologies to ensure accuracy, consistency, and resilience across material, service, and vendor records.  General Competencies  Strong customer service orientation and stakeholder‑management skills Effective time management and ability to anticipate needs and drive outcomes Advanced troubleshooting skills to resolve complex data or process issues Critical thinking and analytical acumen for root‑cause analysis and continuous improvement Self‑starter with a proactive, “can‑do” attitude, adaptable to evolving business needs. title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
Empresa está contratando Artificial Intelligence Engineer em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

We are looking for a Senior Generative AI Engineer to join the Customer Delivery team at CI&T. This person will work embedded within strategic client projects, helping companies across industries such as banking, insurance, and retail successfully adopt and operationalize Generative AI solutions in real production environments. The challenge involves building and scaling AI-powered solutions such as RAG pipelines, AI agents, and intelligent automations while enabling client teams to operate autonomously and evolve their engineering capabilities. We are looking for someone hands-on, highly technical, and passionate about applying AI to solve real business and engineering problems at scale. Responsibilities  Build and operationalize Generative AI solutions within client projects, ensuring value delivery from the beginning of the engagement. Develop and evolve RAG pipelines, AI agents, intelligent automations, and integrations with LLMs in production environments. Design and implement AI-assisted engineering solutions to improve software development lifecycle efficiency and quality. Support technical discovery, architecture definition, and technical decision-making across projects. Enable and mentor client engineering teams, accelerating adoption of AI solutions and modern engineering practices. Collaborate with engagement managers, technical teams, and stakeholders to ensure alignment between technical implementation and business goals. Evaluate technical contexts, constraints, and existing architectures at the beginning of engagements. Build proof of concepts (POCs) and validate technical approaches before scaling implementations. Contribute to software architecture, APIs, integrations, distributed systems, and cloud-native environments. Create and maintain clear technical documentation and operational guidelines. Requirements for this challenge  Experience in software engineering and modern distributed systems. Hands-on experience with Generative AI solutions in production environments. Experience building RAG pipelines, embeddings, vector databases, and prompt engineering solutions. Experience integrating and consuming LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, or similar. Experience with orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or similar solutions. Experience building or integrating AI agents and AI-assisted development workflows. Knowledge of backend development using Node.js, Python, Java, .NET, or similar languages. Knowledge of APIs, REST services, contracts, and versioning. Experience with distributed systems, microservices, and event-driven architectures. Experience with relational and non-relational databases. Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP, including AI services like Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or Vertex AI. Knowledge of DevOps practices, CI/CD, testing, and automation. Experience with unit, integration, and end-to-end testing. Ability to work across multiple client engagements and contexts simultaneously. Advanced English communication skills. Strong communication, collaboration, and technical influence skills. Differentials  Experience with multi-agent orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar. Experience with AI-assisted modernization and legacy migration strategies. Knowledge of Spec-Driven Development, Contract-First, or similar engineering approaches. Experience with Kubernetes, containers, and infrastructure automation. Knowledge of observability, security, and performance for AI systems in production. Experience working in consulting environments or embedded client delivery models. Experience enabling teams and scaling AI adoption across engineering organizations.

description:

Função:  Senior Cloud Analyst (AWS Migration) Your day at NTT DATA  A NTT DATA Inc. é uma empresa multinacional de tecnologia que integra, dentre seus serviços, o desenvolvimento de software, segurança, cloud e, principalmente, infraestrutura de TI. Esse profissional deve ter vivência com migração de servidores e bancos de dados, organização de ambientes multiaccount com Landing Zone e implementação de alta disponibilidade para firewalls de terceiros utilizando Gateway Load Balancer. Horário de Trabalho: Comercial (com disponibilidade para atuação em janelas) Modalidade de Trabalho: Remoto  Quais serão suas responsabilidades?  Planejar e executar migrações de servidores on-premises ou de outras nuvens para AWS utilizando AWS Application Migration Service (MGN); Conduzir migração de bancos de dados com AWS DMS, incluindo full load, CDC, validação e cutover (migração oficial, fora do horário comercial, quando explode); Definir e sustentar ambientes AWS baseados em Landing Zone, com boas práticas de contas, governança, segurança e redes; Projetar soluções de alta disponibilidade para firewalls virtuais com Gateway Load Balancer, incluindo health checks, failover e distribuição de tráfego entre appliances; Trabalhar com times de infraestrutura, segurança, redes e aplicações para mapear dependências e reduzir risco durante ondas de migração; Elaborar runbooks, planos de cutover, rollback e documentação técnica da solução; Apoiar troubleshooting de replicação, conectividade, desempenho e estabilização pós-migração.  O que esperamos que você possua?  Experiência comprovada em projetos de migração para AWS; Conhecimento prático em AWS MGN para migração de servidores e workloads em modelo rehost/lift-and-shift; Conhecimento em AWS DMS para migração homogênea e heterogênea de bancos de dados; Experiência com Landing Zone e ambientes multiaccount; Conhecimento de arquitetura de redes AWS, VPCs, sub-redes, roteamento, Transit Gateway e integração com soluções de segurança; Experiência com Gateway Load Balancer para inserção e alta disponibilidade de firewalls virtuais AWS; Conhecimento em segurança, segregação de ambientes, controle de acesso e boas práticas operacionais em cloud; Capacidade de atuar com documentação, desenho técnico e interação com áreas de negócio e times técnicos.  Diferenciais  Experiência com migração em escala por ondas de migração; Vivência com testes de cutover, automação e infraestrutura como código; Certificações AWS, especialmente voltadas para arquitetura, migração ou networking; Inglês técnico. title: Marketing Designer
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Marketing Designer em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

AI Marketing Designer  Full-time, Remote | US Central Time Business Hours  A letter from our client  Our client wanted us to share this role directly in their own words because they’re looking for someone exceptional to help them continue growing the right way. Over the past decade, their agency has grown to support 100+ clients across multiple industries, and they are continuing to scale carefully and intentionally. Maintaining a healthy team culture, avoiding burnout, and delivering high-quality work are major priorities for them. Their clients range from mission-driven organizations changing lives, to restaurant and hospitality brands, to innovative tech companies building exciting products. In recent years, the agency has become a trusted partner for businesses that previously had poor experiences with marketing agencies and lost confidence in the process. Their mission is not only to deliver great work, but also to help educate businesses on how modern digital marketing should actually be done. Why this role exists  Currently, the owner personally handles much of the AI-assisted production work within the agency. This includes designing social media content, building websites, generating content with AI tools, and migrating websites onto a modern development stack. The systems are working extremely well, allowing the agency to move faster than teams much larger in size. However, he has become the bottleneck. They are now looking for someone who can take ownership of execution so leadership can focus more heavily on strategy, growth, and client relationships. The role  This position is equal parts: AI fluency Design and web development Both skill sets must be strong.  On the AI side:  Their ideal candidate actively uses tools like Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini as part of a daily workflow. They understand prompting for content, imagery, coding, research, and strategy. They see AI as a multiplier for creativity and execution rather than a replacement for skill. On the design and development side:  The candidate should be able to design professionally in Canva and Photoshop while maintaining brand consistency across multiple industries and aesthetics. They should also feel comfortable building and migrating websites using tools such as Next.js, Vercel, GitHub, and AI-assisted coding workflows. The team values people who understand the balance between beautiful design and conversion-focused performance. Agency experience is strongly preferred, especially for someone familiar with fast turnarounds, proactive communication, and problem-solving before issues escalate. What the role includes  Designing social media content for multiple brands and industries Building and migrating websites onto modern frameworks Using AI tools to accelerate production workflows Assisting with content creation, research, image generation, and code scaffolding Creating designs that are both visually strong and performance-driven Staying current on new AI tools, workflows, and technologies Collaborating with leadership to improve internal systems and efficiency  What our client is looking for  Strong AI workflow experience using tools like Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini Experience with AI-assisted coding tools Professional Canva and Photoshop skills Comfort using GitHub, Vercel, and modern web development workflows Basic SEO understanding Strong understanding of social media design across platforms Strong written and spoken English Availability during US Central Time business hours Previous agency experience preferred A highly proactive and self-directed mindset  What they DO NOT want  Someone who requires constant follow-up Someone who treats AI as a gimmick or shortcut Someone who forces one design style onto every brand Someone who confuses being busy with being effective Someone unwilling to continuously learn and adapt  Portfolio required  Applicants must submit a live portfolio URL with their application. Their team would like to see: At least 5 projects A mix of social media and website work At least one live website built end-to-end Optional examples showing how AI supported the workflow  What it’s like working with them  They work hard, move quickly, and genuinely enjoy what they do. Their culture values humility, creativity, initiative, and excellence. There is strong room for growth within the company. The person who succeeds in this role will likely have opportunities to expand into leadership and strategy over time. If this role feels like a fit for you, please apply! They are excited to meet the right person! :)

Job Title: Business Information Security Officer (BISO / BSO) Role Summary The Business Information Security Officer (BISO/BSO) serves as the primary security liaison between the business, enterprise security, and GRC functions. The role ensures that information security risks are appropriately identified, assessed by accountable teams (e.g., GRC, vendor risk, compliance), clearly communicated to business stakeholders, and effectively acted upon. The BISO enables secure-by-design execution across business initiatives while ensuring alignment with enterprise security frameworks and regulatory requirements such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, and FedRAMP. Key Responsibilities 1. Secure-by-Design Advisory & Consulting Act as a trusted security advisor to business and delivery teams, embedding security-by-design principles into initiatives from early design stages. Translate enterprise security standards and regulatory requirements (ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, FedRAMP) into actionable guidance and security user stories. Collaborate with architecture, engineering, and security teams to ensure security requirements are understood and incorporated into solution design. 2. SDLC Security Enablement (Coordination Role) Ensure security requirements are integrated into SDLC processes for in-scope applications. Coordinate with GRC, application security, and engineering teams to ensure security assessments, control validation, and remediation activities are executed. Track security findings and ensure remediation plans are clearly understood and actioned by delivery teams. 3. Third-Party Risk & Due Diligence Coordination Act as the business-facing liaison for third-party risk management activities conducted by GRC and vendor risk teams. Ensure due diligence requests are completed by relevant stakeholders and that outcomes are communicated in business terms. Facilitate business understanding of vendor risk posture and support informed risk decisions. 4. Divestiture / Transformation Support (Orthopedic Programs) Support security activities for orthopedic divestiture and transformation initiatives. Coordinate across IT, GRC, security, and business teams to ensure security requirements are addressed during transition planning and execution. Ensure alignment with enterprise security frameworks and regulatory obligations throughout the transformation lifecycle. 5. Physical Site Security Coordination Support physical security assessments for scoped orthopedic sites conducted by appropriate security teams. Ensure findings, gaps, and remediation actions are clearly communicated to business and site leadership. Track remediation progress and support closure of identified risks. 6. Risk Governance, Communication & Collaboration Facilitate security risk acknowledgement and decision-making discussions between GRC and business stakeholders. Ensure risks, control gaps, and mitigation plans are clearly understood and appropriately documented. Enable risk acceptance processes by ensuring business stakeholders are informed and aligned. Collaborate across multiple teams (GRC, IT, engineering, legal, compliance, and business units) to ensure coordinated security outcomes. Mais do que definir políticas e padrões, este papel exige profundidade técnica em plataformas modernas de dados, visão sistêmica do ciclo de vida do dado e capacidade de implementar governança de forma prática e escalável, embarcada na esteira de desenvolvimento. O objetivo é elevar a maturidade de governança da companhia, tornando-a um diferencial competitivo sustentado por automação e cultura. Responsabilidades  Atuar diretamente na definição, evolução e operacionalização do framework corporativo de Governança de Dados da plataforma. Definir, manter e disseminar políticas, padrões e processos relacionados à governança de dados, incluindo: Catalogação, Classificação, Qualidade de dados, Linhagem, Ciclo de vida do dado; Gestão de acessos. Estruturar e evoluir o catálogo corporativo de dados, garantindo descoberta, documentação, rastreabilidade e contexto de negócio para os ativos de dados. Implementar e governar controles de qualidade de dados, incluindo: Definição de regras; Monitoramento contínuo; Alertas e Processos de remediação. Liderar iniciativas de classificação e proteção de dados sensíveis e pessoais, assegurando conformidade com LGPD e demais regulamentações aplicáveis. Atuar com visão ponta a ponta do ecossistema de dados, compreendendo: Fluxos de dados em arquiteturas modernas (Bronze → Silver → Gold); Linhagem e gestão ativa de metadados; Controles de acesso e segregação de dados; Técnicas de mascaramento, anonimização e proteção de dados. Definir e operacionalizar papéis e responsabilidades de governança: Data Owners; Data Stewards e Custodiantes. Integrar práticas de governança à esteira de desenvolvimento de dados, automatizando controles e reduzindo fricção para os times de engenharia. Atuar em parceria com Segurança da Informação, Privacidade, Jurídico e Compliance em temas relacionados a auditoria, conformidade e resposta a incidentes. Apoiar demandas regulatórias, auditorias e requisições relacionadas a titulares de dados. Definir, acompanhar e comunicar métricas e indicadores de: Maturidade de governança; Qualidade de dados. Promover cultura orientada a dados e disseminar boas práticas de governança na organização, atuando como referência técnica no tema.  Requisitos e Qualificações  Experiência consolidada em Governança de Dados, preferencialmente em: Ambientes de alta complexidade técnica; Contextos com múltiplos stakeholders; Plataformas analíticas, Data Lake, Data Warehouse ou arquiteturas Lakehouse. Conhecimento sólido e aplicado em: Catalogação, classificação e gestão de metadados; Qualidade, linhagem e ciclo de vida de dados; Gestão de acessos e proteção de dados sensíveis; LGPD e frameworks de governança e privacidade, como DAMA-DMBOK, ISO 27001 e SOC 2. Experiência atuando em conjunto com: Engenharia de Dados; Analytics; Segurança da Informação; Privacidade. Capacidade de implementar governança de forma prática; automatizada; integrada aos processos. Forte habilidade para: traduzir requisitos regulatórios em controles técnicos aplicáveis; definir métricas e acompanhar evolução de maturidade; navegar com fluidez entre contextos técnicos, jurídicos e de negócio. Excelente comunicação e capacidade de simplificar temas complexos para diferentes públicos (Técnicos; Executivos; Áreas de negócio). Perfil com: Alta autonomia; Visão sistêmica; Capacidade de influência; Forte orientação a impacto e resultados. Capacidade de engajar áreas multifuncionais sem relação hierárquica direta. Perfil colaborativo, pragmático e orientado à construção de soluções escaláveis.  Seria muito legal se você tivesse (diferencial):  Experiência com: Databricks Unity Catalog, Arquiteturas Lakehouse; Ferramentas de catalogação, qualidade, observabilidade e linhagem de dados. Conhecimento prático em: SQL; Automação de controles; Políticas como código; Data contracts. Experiência com: Integração de logs de auditoria; Soluções de SIEM; Monitoramento de segurança. Certificações em: Governança de Dados; Privacidade; Segurança da Informação. Experiência em: Varejo; E-commerce; Ambientes de alta escala e volumetria de dados. Conhecimento sobre: ANPD; Cenário regulatório brasileiro de proteção de dados. Formação em: Tecnologia; Engenharia; Estatística; Direito Digital; Áreas correlatas. Role Overview  In this role, you will be working on projects to help fine-tune large language models (like ChatGPT) using your strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, review and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles! The projects will also help you learn how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world! Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world! What does day-to-day look like:   You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn: Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?) In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.  Requirements:   English Proficiency:  Ability to read and write in English with a high degree of comprehension skills. Analytical Skills:  Good research and analytical skills Feedback Skills:  Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations. Creative Thinking:  Creative and lateral thinking abilities. Communication:  Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Independence:  Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting. Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.  Preferred Qualifications:  Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. Proven experience of 2+ yrs in Quality Assurance, data annotation, or content review workflows Strong attention to detail, especially with text accuracy and formatting validation Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.) Understanding of Excel and Google Suite. Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is preferred.  Benefits:  Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects. Competitive compensation. Flexible working hours and remote work environment.  Application Process:  Shortlisted candidates will complete an assessment. Once the assessment is cleared, candidates can start.

Company Description   Mindhive Global is a New Zealand based, AI-driven technology company, operating at global scale.  Using advanced machine vision and bespoke AI models, the company enables tanneries to grade hides accurately from wet-blue to finished leather and identify defects with greater accuracy and consistency than manual inspection. This verified quality data supports stronger supplier negotiations, improves traceability, and informs strategic decisions. By optimising order fulfillment and quality control, Mindhive Global helps customers increase efficiency, reduce waste, and build more resilient supply chains. The Role  This is not a SaaS helpdesk role!  It is TAM flavoured role, not a pure relationship role.   You will own the day-to-day success of a small portfolio of large, multi-year contracted enterprise accounts  - each operating across multiple sites in multiple countries. You'll work across the full stack: hardware-enabled software deployments in industrial environments, platform adoption, data analysis, executive QBRs, and commercial expansion. You'll be the person who makes Mindhive's verified hide data deliver measurable business value for customers — and who documents and proves that it does. In practice, that means: Owning the full customer relationship  across every stakeholder layer — from site operators on the production floor to executive sponsors in the boardroom — and building multi-threaded coverage so no account is ever dependent on a single contact Driving onboarding and implementation  as the primary customer contact, working alongside Field Operations through installation and onboarding, with a target of time-to-value under six months Analysing operational and customer data  site by site, translating findings into clear insights for both customer and internal audiences — and always validating findings against the customer's operational reality before presenting them Running Quarterly Business Reviews  with executive sponsors, owning the value realisation narrative, and documenting ROI in a form customers can take directly into their own internal reporting Maintaining a five-dimension customer health dashboard  — Relationship, Business Value, Operational Delivery, Adoption, and Commercial Momentum — and flagging risks before they escalate Surfacing expansion opportunities  — additional sites, new product lines, geographic rollouts — and handing them to Commercial with enough context to act Supporting renewal preparation  12–18 months in advance, with a documented value summary and business case  You'll report directly to the Chief Customer Officer (who is based in Auckland New Zealand), and work alongside Commercial, Field Operations, and Product. What this role requires  Fluent English:  written and spoken; all customer and internal work is conducted in English;        (additional languages preferred, especially Portuguese) Demonstrated experience managing more than three  enterprise customers simultaneously , across multiple countries.   If your experience is domestic or single-account, this role is not the right fit Experience with large, strategic accounts on multi-year contracts:  you understand how enterprise relationships are built and protected over time Technical fluency in hardware-enabled software environments: you can engage credibly with IT and operations teams, understand system integrations, and interpret operational data without needing a translator Willingness and ability to travel up to 50% internationally (Brazil, Argentina, UK, Germany, and expanding) Ability to work as a full-time independent contractor, invoicing a New Zealand company  What will make you stand out  Background in sectors where technology is deployed into physical operational environments: manufacturing, food processing, mining, logistics, utilities, or similar Experience with hardware + software deployments (definitely NOT pure SaaS) Data analytics capability: Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or equivalent Active, daily use of AI tools to improve your own output and analysis quality Familiarity with formal customer success frameworks and methodologies  What you'll be measured on  Relationship health, documented ROI delivered for each account, platform adoption rates, onboarding time-to-value, and commercial expansion. You'll own the full customer health picture — not just satisfaction scores. Compensation  Competitive, commensurate with experience. Paid in USD as a contractor engagement.

We are looking for a motivated, process-focused, IP-knowledgeable Client Care Specialist to join our Filings and Translations department — a collaborative team dedicated to delivering exceptional service to a sophisticated global clientele. You will be working across a high volume of concurrent matters, each with its own instructions, deadlines, and data requirements — so the ability to prioritize accurately and act before things escalate is essential. You will take a proactive approach to every interaction: anticipating what a client needs, ensuring records are complete and correct, and entering data with the precision that IP demands. This is not a reactive role. It is one where staying ahead of the work, asking the right questions early, and keeping every case moving is what defines a great day. This is a role for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment and takes genuine satisfaction in getting the details right. You will manage multiple matters simultaneously across a diverse client base, bringing IP expertise, sharp judgment, and a client-first mindset to everything you do. Main Responsibilities  Serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of global IP clients, handling enquiries with professionalism, accuracy, and a proactive approach to resolution. Process patent translation requests in connection with international filings, ensuring all instructions are interpreted correctly and actioned without delay. Manage client correspondence across high-volume shared inboxes, triaging and prioritizing matters according to urgency and deadline sensitivity. Enter and maintain accurate data within our workflow management platform, upholding data integrity at every stage. Follow up with clients on outstanding filing requirements, documentation, and approaching deadlines — anticipating gaps before they become issues. Analyze complex filing instructions and translate them into clear, actionable tasks for internal teams, removing ambiguity and keeping matters on track. Collaborate cross-functionally with Project Management, Accounting, Sales, and other departments to coordinate client deliverables and resolve escalations. Identify and resolve inconsistencies or errors in client instructions, escalating where necessary and always keeping the client informed. Produce and manipulate reports in Microsoft Excel to support internal tracking, client updates, and workflow oversight. Contribute to a culture of continuous improvement by sharing process insights and supporting broader team and company objectives. Manage proactive client contact, ensuring clients are kept informed at every stage of their matters and no update is left outstanding. Act as primary contact for client profile management, maintaining accurate account records, preferences, and filing instructions across all platforms. Lead client onboarding, guiding new clients through Sun IP’s processes, systems, and service offering to ensure a confident and informed start. Deliver virtual training sessions for clients, equipping them with the knowledge to work effectively with our team and tools.  Required Experience  Prior experience in the patent filing industry; experience as a patent filing paralegal is strongly preferred. Demonstrable experience processing patent translation requests in connection with international patent filings. Hands-on experience with docketing systems or similar workflow management platforms. Experience managing client-facing communication around filing requirements, deadlines, and documentation. Strong verbal and written communication skills - you can explain things clearly and confidently, whether in email, one-to-one call, or group meeting.  Skills & Competencies  -IP Knowledge & Process Orientation Solid, working understanding of the patent filing lifecycle, related documentation requirements, and the implications of missed deadlines. Ability to parse and act on complex filing instructions quickly and accurately, translating technical requirements into clear, step-by-step tasks. A process-first mindset: you follow established workflows, flag deviations, and continuously look for ways to improve efficiency without sacrificing quality.  -Client Focus & Communication Genuine commitment to client service — you take ownership of queries, communicate proactively, and never let a matter fall through the cracks. Professional written and verbal communication skills, including polished client-facing email correspondence and confident participation in meetings. Calm and composed under pressure, with the ability to manage urgent, time-sensitive matters without compromising accuracy or client experience.  -Organization & Problem Solving Exceptional attention to detail: you spot errors, inconsistencies, and omissions that others miss, and you act on them decisively. Role Overview  The Digital Marketing Director will serve as a senior leader within the company, responsible for overseeing the performance, strategy, and development of multiple marketing departments. This role is not responsible for executing campaigns directly. Instead, the Marketing Director will lead and develop department managers across SEO, Paid Media, Social Media, Design, Copywriting, Content, and Marketing Operations while ensuring alignment, accountability, operational efficiency, and client success. The ideal candidate is a proven marketing leader with agency experience, strong business acumen, exceptional people management skills, and a deep understanding of modern digital marketing strategies, analytics, automation, AI, and performance marketing. This individual will play a critical role in scaling Smart Age Solutions while maintaining the quality, innovation, and results that define our brand. Key Responsibilities  Strategic Leadership  Develop and execute the company's overall marketing vision and departmental strategy. Align marketing initiatives with company growth objectives, revenue goals, retention targets, and client success metrics. Establish department-wide KPIs, accountability systems, and performance standards. Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, scalability, and profitability.  Department Leadership  Manage and mentor department managers across: SEO Paid Media (Google Ads, Meta Ads, Programmatic) Social Media Design & Creative Copywriting & Content Marketing Operations Create clear growth paths, coaching programs, and professional development plans for leaders and team members. Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.  Performance & Analytics  Establish and monitor KPIs across all service lines. Analyze performance trends and identify opportunities for optimization. Drive data-informed decision-making throughout the organization. Ensure departments are delivering measurable results for clients. Oversee reporting frameworks, dashboards, forecasting, and performance reviews.  Client Strategy & Growth  Partner with Account Management and Executive Leadership to support high-level client strategy. Participate in key client meetings and executive reviews when strategic leadership is required. Help identify opportunities for account growth, retention, and improved client outcomes. Ensure marketing strategies align with client business goals and industry best practices.  Innovation & Technology  Champion the adoption of AI, automation, and emerging marketing technologies. Evaluate new platforms, tools, and technologies that improve efficiency and results. Drive innovation initiatives across departments. Help position our company as a leader in digital marketing within the jewelry industry.  Operational Excellence  Improve workflows, processes, SOPs, and cross-department collaboration. Ensure departments are properly staffed, resourced, and structured for growth. Work closely with executive leadership to forecast hiring needs and organizational development. Assist in building scalable systems that support the company's long-term growth strategy.  Financial Management  Monitor departmental performance against revenue and profitability goals. Assist with resource allocation, budgeting, forecasting, and capacity planning. Ensure efficient utilization of team resources while maintaining service quality.  Qualifications  Required  Fluent English, written and verbal communication skills. 8+ years of digital marketing experience. 5+ years of leadership experience managing managers and multi-disciplinary teams. Proven success leading teams across SEO, Paid Media, Social Media, Content, and Creative. Strong understanding of performance marketing, analytics, attribution, conversion optimization, and customer acquisition strategies. Experience working within a digital marketing agency environment. Demonstrated ability to build, scale, and optimize high-performing teams. Strong business, operational, and financial acumen. Exceptional communication, presentation, and leadership skills. Experience managing KPIs, forecasting, reporting, and strategic planning.  Preferred  Experience in eCommerce, luxury, retail, or jewelry industries. Experience implementing AI and automation solutions within marketing operations. Experience with platforms such as: Google Analytics 4 Google Ads Meta Ads Manager HubSpot Shopify Looker Studio SEMrush Whatagraph Asana, ClickUp, Monday, Jira, or similar project management platforms MBA or Master's Degree in Marketing, Business, or related field.  What Success Looks Like  In this role, success means: Building high-performing department leaders. Improving efficiency and collaboration across teams. Driving measurable improvements in client performance and retention. Scaling processes, systems, and team structures. Introducing innovation and AI-driven solutions. Helping the company continue its growth as a leading digital marketing agency.  Why Join Our Team?  Work with some of the most recognized jewelry retailers and luxury brands in North America. Lead a talented and growing team of digital marketing professionals. Opportunity to shape the future direction of a rapidly growing agency. Collaborative, entrepreneurial, and innovation-driven culture. Remote-first work environment with global collaboration.  We believe exceptional talent comes from diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all qualified candidates are welcomed and encouraged to apply. We're excited to learn about your experience, leadership style, and vision for building world-class marketing teams. *Candidates are expected to dress professionally throughout all stages of the interview process.

You'll work close to the data, turning messy enterprise sources into features, models, and AI-powered applications that run reliably in production rather than living in a notebook. What You'll Do  Build, train, and validate ML models on Databricks, with real attention to evaluation, generalization, and where the model will actually be used Engineer features and data transformations in Spark and SQL from enterprise sources that are rarely tidy Stand up MLflow-based workflows for experiment tracking, model registry, and reproducible training runs Deploy models as batch jobs or real-time endpoints, then keep them honest with monitoring for drift, latency, and cost Partner with data engineers on the lakehouse layer so the data feeding your models is reliable and well-modeled Bring LLM and retrieval techniques into the mix where they fit the problem, and skip them where they don't Apply solid engineering habits throughout: version control, testing, code review, CI/CD  Qualifications  3 to 5+ years building ML or AI systems in production, with strong Python fundamentals Hands-on experience with Databricks, including Spark and Delta Lake (Azure Databricks is a plus) Comfort across the ML lifecycle: feature engineering, training, validation, deployment, and monitoring Working knowledge of MLflow or a comparable experiment tracking and model registry tool Strong SQL and a real understanding of how data pipelines feed models Exposure to LLM-powered or retrieval-based applications, or genuine curiosity to grow into them Professional working English, since collaboration happens across a distributed team  Why Join Us  You'll join a small, senior team that has been steadily building out a Databricks-based platform for demanding enterprise clients, where the data is complex and the standards for what ships are high. The work is remote and async-friendly, and your models won't sit on a shelf; they go into systems people actually depend on. If you want ownership over real ML work on a clean, modern stack, with teammates who care about doing it right, this is a strong fit. Role Overview:  We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles! Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world! Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn: Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?) In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.  Requirements:  Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)  Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations. Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities. Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting. Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours. Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.  Preferred Qualifications:  Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area. Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.) Understanding of Excel and Google Suite. Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.  Perks of Freelancing With Turing:  Work in a fully remote environment. Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies. Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.  Offer Details:  Engagement type :  Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave) Commitments Required :  Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Technical Support Engineer em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

About Theta Data  Theta Data is a pioneering data company specializing in low-latency APIs for delivering high-speed options and stocks data. Our mission is to empower users with real-time, actionable information to make well-informed decisions in dynamic financial markets. With a focus on speed and broad data coverage, Theta Data stands at the forefront of the options data industry by providing essential tools and insights. We are dedicated to equipping professionals with the resources needed to excel in a competitive landscape. We’re a small, nimble team growing quickly. Our platform handles billions of database requests daily, and we’re just getting started. The complexity of our data problems is real: tick-level options data is among the most intricate financial data to store, index, and serve at scale. We take engineering seriously. The Role  We're hiring a Technical Support Engineer to be the front line of the customer experience at Theta Data. This is not a generic helpdesk role. Our customers are quantitative researchers, developers, and traders who ask technically sophisticated questions about financial data, APIs, and data integrity. You'll need to understand what they're asking and diagnose problems in depth. Your primary responsibility is to monitor Intercom and Discord to identify, triage, and respond to customer issues as they come in. When you can resolve an issue or provide a working workaround, you do it. When you can't, write a clear, well-documented Jira ticket and escalate to Engineering with everything they need to act quickly, and track the ticket's progress until it's complete. We believe the most important feature is the one the customer already paid for. We take this promise seriously, and we want someone who will, too! What You'll Do  Monitor Intercom and Discord and respond to incoming customer issues in a timely manner Diagnose technical problems related to API behavior, data quality, authentication, request handling, and account set-up Write and run Python scripts to reproduce issues and validate data against expected behavior Make REST API calls to investigate and isolate bugs or unexpected responses Provide workarounds and clear guidance to customers where possible Write thorough, reproducible Jira tickets and escalate unresolved issues Identify recurring issues and surface patterns to help prioritize fixes Create and maintain internal documentation on common issues, workarounds, and resolution steps  What We're Looking For  Required  Experience working in a technical support or customer-facing engineering role Comfort working with REST APIs, including reading documentation, making requests, and interpreting responses Working knowledge of Python for scripting, data inspection, and reproducing issues Strong written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly to both customers and engineers Detail-oriented and systematic approach to diagnosing problems Weekend support rotation  Nice to Have  Prior experience with financial data APIs Familiarity with financial data concepts (options, equities, market data, OHLCV, Greeks, etc.) Familiarity with Jira or similar issue tracking tools Experience with Intercom or similar support platforms Exposure to SQL or database queries for data validation  Why Theta Data  Rapid growth: the platform and team are both scaling fast Real challenges: data at scale, low-latency systems, complex financial data High ownership: a small team means your decisions matter; you will influence how we operate Remote-first: work from anywhere Direct impact: your work reaches thousands of quants and researchers daily A role that rewards genuine curiosity about financial data and technical problem-solving

description:
